pool.text: The main building in the Kasbah was begun on the site of an older building.
Khair-ad-Din Barbarossa began the inner harbour to accommodate his pirate vessels.
A lighthouse was built occupying the site of Fort Penon.
A citadel, Palace of the Dey was constructed at the highest point in the wall.
Le Bastion 23 was built by Dey Ramdhan Pacha in the lower Casbah.
Two Algerine pirate crews landed in Ireland, sacked Baltimore, and enslaved its inhabitants.
Charles Boyer and Hedy Lamarr starred in Algiers, directed by John Cromwell.
Bud Abbott and Lou Costello starred in Abbott and Costello in the Foreign Legion.
The 10th Parachute Division of the French Army led attacks against independence fighters.
Youssef Chahine directed the film Jamila, the Algerian.
Algeria achieved independence with Algiers serving as its capital.
Gillo Pontecorvo directed the film The Battle of Algiers.
Mohammed Zinet directed the film Tahya ya Didou, Alger Insolite.
The monument was opened on the 20th anniversary of Algeria's independence.
Algiers was the site of demonstrations demanding the end of the single-party system.
The Algerian constitutional referendum took place and a new constitution was adopted.
A political entity dominated by religious conservatives engaged in a political test of wills.
The Kasbah of Algiers was enlisted as a cultural world heritage site by UNESCO.
Considerable land reclamation along the waterfront allowed for developments such as Marina Mall.
A paper was published estimating future climate conditions for Algiers by 2100.
